posts.t: Hi TTF. I'll also enjoy Kovalenko's reply. I personally think that TT would now be very rare in Alex Trading. I may be wrong, but I think that is why he says " just follow the Market ". I think that to look for a clear entry signal (candles pattern?) at certain key levels can much reduce your risk. When we set a TT we are just going to accept whatever will be. Hope to read Alex comment.

posts.t: Yellow - key Swings on H 1, then we had strong Drop, price broke 2 Swings ( H and Hl). When i saw nice Droping, I marked QM level where, i wanted to see reaction of price. Notice- price makes nice CP to Qm level, then we had 2 BEOB on H1 (for me this second BEOB) was a signal to sell). I took manually this trade. Last time I like to have confirmations!
posts.fa: زرد — سوئینگ‌های کلیدی روی H1؛ بعد یک ریزش قوی داشتیم و قیمت 2 سوئینگ رو شکست (H و Hl). وقتی ریزش خوبی دیدم، سطح QM رو جایی که می‌خواستم واکنش قیمت رو ببینم علامت زدم. دقت کن — قیمت یک CP خوب تا سطح QM ساخت، بعد 2 تا BEOB روی H1 داشتیم (برای من همین BEOB دوم) سیگنال فروش بود. این معامله رو دستی گرفتم. این اواخر دوست دارم تأیید داشته باشم!
